scene: The glowing map unlocks transit tubes leading away from the windy track.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a hub platform on the racetrack. On the far left, a round glass elevator awaits. Near left, the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair inspects transit gates. At the centre dock, a tiny brass steam train puffs smoke. On the far right, a shiny star shuttle rests with hatch open.
shown: a bubble-like glass elevator with sliding doors waiting on the far left
a brass puffing steam train halted at the centre platform dock
a sleek star shuttle resting with an open hatch on the far right
